# Shrinath Prabhu - shrinath.me

> Senior Staff Frontend Engineer with 8+ years of experience. Currently at Avail Project. Previously led frontend at Arcana Network (4.5 years, through acquisition).

Available for full-time remote roles (Senior/Staff Frontend Engineer, Technical Lead, Engineering Manager), fractional engagements (20–30 hours/week), and technical advisory. Interested in AI, SaaS, developer tools, fintech, and Web3. Core stack: Vue 3, Nuxt 3, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Chrome Extensions (Manifest V3), and Web3 (non-custodial wallets, cross-chain bridging, chain abstraction).

## Side Projects

- [Outline Analytics](https://useoutline.xyz): Privacy-first, cookie-free web analytics. TypeScript SDK (<4KB, zero deps), Bun + Elysia.js backend, MongoDB timeseries. Open source.
- [Credenstore](https://credenstore.web.app): Serverless zero-knowledge encrypted storage using Triplesec symmetric encryption.
